title: tooling(console): build-console.sh tests OBJECTUI_ROOT with `-d .git`, so a linked objectui worktree is ignored and the build silently uses the shared sibling checkout
body:
Filing gate ① — a `finding`: a repo script silently swaps the checkout it was told to use. reach: `scripts/build-console.sh`, which `pnpm objectui:build` runs (AGENTS.md: "Moving the pin has a second half: regenerate the committed manifest — `pnpm objectui:build` …").

## What is wrong

At `origin/main` `27a8b33dec`, `scripts/build-console.sh:162`–`:166`:

```bash
if [[ -n "${OBJECTUI_ROOT:-}" && -d "${OBJECTUI_ROOT}/.git" ]]; then
  SOURCE_ROOT="$OBJECTUI_ROOT"
elif [[ -d "${FRAMEWORK_ROOT}/../objectui/.git" ]]; then
  SOURCE_ROOT="$(cd "${FRAMEWORK_ROOT}/../objectui" && pwd)"
fi
```

- In a linked git worktree, `.git` is a regular file holding a `gitdir:` pointer, so `-d` is false for every linked objectui worktree.
- An `OBJECTUI_ROOT` that names one is ignored with no message, and the script falls back to the sibling `../objectui` checkout.
- It then works in that shared checkout: `git fetch` when the pin is missing (`:178`–`:179`), `git worktree prune` (`:200`), and the build worktree for `.cache/objectui-<sha>` is registered there.

`scripts/bump-objectui.sh` already fixed the same test. Its comment at `:157`–`:160` reads: "`-e`, not `-d`: in a git WORKTREE `.git` is a regular file holding a `gitdir:` pointer, so a `-d` test rejected every linked worktree — and AGENTS.md requires one per task, so this rejected the mandated workflow and only ever worked from a primary clone." `build-console.sh` did not get the same change.

## Where it was met

- On PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22412 (the console pin bump for #22385), the dev saw the fallback and recorded it in the PR's Acceptance notes.
- The dev built from a scratch repository that uses objectui's object store as an alternate, so nothing was registered in the shared checkout.
- The at-tier contract review on that PR (`6075438386`) escalated it as owed a card. This is that card.

## Done when

- `build-console.sh` accepts a linked worktree as `OBJECTUI_ROOT`, the way `bump-objectui.sh` does.
- An `OBJECTUI_ROOT` that is set but is not a checkout is refused with a message. It is never silently replaced by the sibling.
- The fix is pinned by a test or self-test the repo already runs.
